Hooks That Trigger on File Create or Delete

Deleting a file can trigger a whole cleanup routine.
Create-triggered hooks can scaffold boilerplate the moment a new file appears.
Delete-triggered hooks can clean up related test files or imports.
It's automation tied to your actual file lifecycle.
